name: Homberg (Efze, Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and white, charged above the centre with the city arms of Homberg (Efze) (a Hessian lion on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Homberg (Efze); German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Homberg (Efze) arms — Hessian lion on blue
